title: Screening fOR Throat Cancer
summary: This study will screen people for biomarkers of Human Papillomavirus (HPV) to form a cohort of people who may be at increased risk of HPV-oropharyngeal cancer (HPV-OPC). The investigators will follow these individuals prospectively to evaluate risk for OPC.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Part I: Participants in Screening

To be eligible to participate in Part I of this study, an individual must meet the following criteria:

Community and Internet Screen eligibility:

* Male, 40-69 years old
* Willing to self-collect or come in person to collect screening biospecimens
* Willing to be contacted to arrange follow-up visits, if determined to be eligible for follow-up
* Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document

Biorepository Screen eligibility:

* Male, 40-69 years old
* Active participant within MWCCS
* Willing to be contacted to arrange follow-up visits, if determined to be eligible for follow-up
* Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document

  * Part II: Participants in Follow-Up

To be eligible to participate in Part II of this study, an individual must meet all of the following criteria:

* HPV16 biomarker detected in Part I screen
* Willingness to complete annual follow-up visits

Exclusion Criteria:

* Part I: Participants in Screening

An individual who meets any of the following criteria will be excluded from participation in this study:

* Presence of medical or psychiatric condition affecting ability to give voluntary, informed consent.
* Participants who do not speak English cannot enroll because the consent and study survey are only available in English. However, if there is a hearing, literacy, or minor fluency issue and the participant requests assistance from a family member or the study coordinator, this individual may still enroll and receive this assistance to ensure the participant fully hears and understands everything being asked.
* History of head and neck cancer

  * Part II: Participants in Follow-Up

An individual who meets any of the following criteria will be excluded from participation in this part of the study:

• Unable to complete annual follow-up visits
